title: Day tasks
intro: Each day you take a few things, and the day is coloured by what got done: 🟩 all · 🟨 nearly · 🟧 over half · 🟥 a little · ⬛ nothing.
notTaken: The day is not taken yet. Take this set?
proposalEmpty: No open tasks. You can take an empty day and add tasks later.
pastReadOnly: A past day can only be viewed.

errors.tooLate: A task can leave today only until 12:00. A past day does not change.
errors.notFound: Task not found. Maybe it was deleted.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

settings.title: Day tasks
settings.enabledHint: Off: they leave the menu and the calendar; what was taken is kept.
settings.targetHint: A new number applies from the next day you take.
settings.paintBefore: Colour days before the first one taken
settings.paintBeforeHint: Off: those days stay uncoloured. On: they are ⬛.

pin.which: Which day should it go to?
